title: UCL EPSRC Doctoral Landscape Award (UELA) Studentships
about: UCL EPSRC Doctoral Landscape Award studentships for 2027/28, starting 1 October 2027. Applicants choose up to three of 133 advertised projects. Deadline 8 January 2027 at noon UK time; UCL advises submitting applications and references by 16 December 2026. International places are capped at 30%.
requirements: Two references submitted by the application deadline
